what: The day-one spike (paypal/spike.py) on the real PayPal sandbox, run by GitHub Actions with the repository's secrets: https://github.com/Ritapossible/RedLine/actions/runs/41190365378
findings: A sandbox card with intent AUTHORIZE returns a COMPLETED order carrying the authorization: no buyer step.
Partial capture with final_capture false leaves PARTIALLY_CAPTURED; void then gives VOIDED; captured + released == authorized.
final_capture true on a partial capture ends the authorization CAPTURED and releases the rest: a later void is refused.
Reauthorizing inside the 3-day honor period is refused with 422.
